title: Model override grant
description: Authorises ONE governed harness run to pass --model, overriding an agent's pinned model. Fail-closed by construction: absence of a grant is denial, and several fields are const so that an over-broad grant cannot be EXPRESSED rather than merely rejected.

agentId.description: The exact agent. A grant naming no agent, or a wildcard, is not expressible.

model.description: The exact model. Wildcards are refused by pattern: a grant must name what will run, not a family.

taskId.description: The task the override serves. Task-bound by construction.

decisionRecord.description: The canonical record carrying the acceptance.

acceptedBy.description: Sole acceptance authority. A const, so a self-accepted grant cannot be expressed.

reason.description: Why the pinned model is insufficient for this run. Length floor deters a placeholder.

reversal.description: How the run is undone. If it cannot be described, it is not reversible.

singleUse.description: A const, so a STANDING override cannot be expressed. One grant, one run.
